testimonials.name: Dr. K. Srinivas Rao
testimonials.content: AMK INFRA and A. Charan Patel delivered our dream home right on schedule. The structural quality, marble finishing, and Vastu compliance exceeded all our expectations. Charan garu’s transparent billing and daily WhatsApp video updates gave us complete peace of mind.

testimonials.name: V. Madhusudhan Reddy
testimonials.content: We partnered with AMK INFRA for our 4-storey commercial shopping complex in Kazipet. Their engineering expertise, modern machinery, and swift municipal clearance assistance saved us months of delay. Truly Warangal's most dependable construction firm.

testimonials.name: Rajeshwari Sharma
testimonials.content: The interior team transformed our 3BHK flat with factory-precision modular woodwork and gorgeous ambient lighting. Charan Patel and his team were polite, meticulous, and delivered a showroom-grade finish within our exact budget.

testimonials.name: P. Raghava Rao
testimonials.content: From 32-camera IP CCTV installation to 3-phase heavy industrial power panels, AMK INFRA executed the entire project with zero downtime to our factory. Super responsive after-sales support.
